customManagers.description: PyPI versions pinned inline in a workflow run step. No built-in manager reads the text of a run: step - github-actions parses uses:, container: and services: only - so without this entry a pin such as `uvx --no-build --from commitizen==X` or `uv run --with pyyaml==X` freezes silently while the same tool keeps moving everywhere else. Renovate's own customManagers:githubActionsVersions preset does not cover these: its regex requires the `NAME_VERSION: <value>` colon form of a YAML env entry

The semgrep version the rule baseline was measured on. reusable-polarion-semgrep.yml and semgrep-rules-test.yml both read it out of this file and interpolate it into `uvx semgrep==${version}`, so the pin lives here and nothing else sees it

npm package versions pinned inline in an npx invocation. Nothing else reads them, and the alternative is the `@latest` this replaced, which resolves at run time and therefore gives a reusable workflow a different linter on every call

packageRules.description: Ungroup GitHub Actions so a single fast-releasing action cannot hold the whole group behind the minimumReleaseAge gate
anthropics/claude-code-action releases more often than the 3-day stability gate, so it never matures; track it with no soak so it updates

The customManagers above pin commit-gate and scan tooling, not anything this repository ships, so they stay `chore` against the preset's rule typing every dependency `fix` - the same reason the preset carves out the github-actions and pre-commit managers

actionlint is declared twice for one gate and the two sides are read by DIFFERENT managers - `reviewdog/action-actionlint` in reusable-actionlint.yml by github-actions, and the `kjanat/actionlint` rev in .pre-commit-config.yaml by pre-commit - so ungrouped they arrive as two separately mergeable pull requests. The action bakes its actionlint binary into its own image and exposes no input to select it, so a bump of the action silently changes which linter CI runs while the commit gate stays where it was, and the divergence surfaces as a red default branch on whatever pull request is open. Measured: 5535848 moved the action alone, took CI from upstream rhysd 1.7.12 to the fork 1.17.0, and turned main red. Grouping puts both bumps in ONE branch, which the preset then automerges to the default branch without a pull request. This rule must stay after the github-actions ungrouping rule above, which nulls the group for every action

pyyaml and commitizen are each declared twice for the same gate - once as an inline pin in a workflow run step, once in .pre-commit-config.yaml - and the two sides are read by DIFFERENT managers (custom.regex and pre-commit), so ungrouped they arrive as two separately automerged pull requests and the advisory hook runs a different version from the binding gate in between. One branch moves both. commitizen needs both spellings because the workflow pin resolves through pypi as `commitizen` while the hook rev resolves through github-tags as `commitizen-tools/commitizen`. This rule must stay last: packageRules apply in array order and the preset groups the pre-commit manager into `pre-commit hooks`, which this overrides for these three names only
